description: Measured per-preset voice-VCA corrections. Initial 2,000 stress fixtures supplied negative trims; later complete 23-scenario unity-master evidence supplied bounded quiet-default boosts and extra headroom. A complete 2,000-fixture long-held/cycle audit supplied ten further headroom trims. No rendered audio is normalized. Every changed FXP requires fresh native QA.
